The uptime audit

Two days on site, one engineer, and a written list of the twelve changes that would remove the most downtime from your plant this year. No obligation to buy anything afterwards.

Book the audit

Request your audit

Enter your email address and an engineer will call within one working day.

By submitting this form you agree to our privacy policy and terms of use.

What the two days cover

  • A walk of every line with the shift that runs it.
  • Extraction of twelve months of stoppage records from your existing historian.
  • A ranked list of causes, with the cost of each one in production hours.

The output is a document you keep whether or not you buy anything from Northwind, and it names the changes we would not charge for alongside the ones we would.
